decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to the London Division of the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission.

Condition : 3 - All new internal works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, with removed railings stored safely for potential re-use..

Condition : 4 - Prior to any works commencing full details of the specifications of the proposed platforms and the means of fixing them to the existing building, to include types of finishing at the edges where cut or ramped, and the details of the flooring material, shall be submitted to, and shall be approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority, and the details as approved shall be implemented only as approved.
description: Installation of steel floor to cover existing machinery well, and a demountable steel floor to cover existing well in turbine floor of engine house (Listed Building Consent)
